title: Decision-readiness register - one row per requirement, with the gate that blocks it and the number that would clear it

status.delivered: the requirement is met by an artefact that a reviewer can open right now
status.delivered-partially: the structure exists and is published, but a stated part of it cannot be filled from an official source yet
status.blocked: nothing can be published honestly until a named source or dataset exists
status.rejected: the brief itself rejects this; recorded so nobody re-proposes it as new work
status.delivered-elsewhere: the artefact exists in a sibling namespace of this repository; this session located it and links it, but did not re-verify its numbers line by line

how_to_read.gate: the single thing that stands between today and the requirement being done
how_to_read.clearing_number: the count that proves the gate is cleared, in the unit the reviewer can check
how_to_read.evidence: repo artefact built this session, or an official URL read this session; 'peer:' means another session's namespace holds it and this session only located it, it was not re-verified
